verdict.rationale: PCI DSS scope reduction through tokenization is a fair question for a payment gateway, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions tokenization, PCI DSS compliance, hosted card fields, or card data bypassing merchant servers. The fraud-protection claim is a related security feature and does not show reduced PCI scope.

support.subject: As a developer, I can keep my systems out of most of PCI DSS scope because card data is tokenized and never touches my servers
